title: buglossoides arvensis subsp. splitgerberi
intro: Buglossoides arvensis subsp. splitgerberi, commonly known as Split-gerbera bugloss or Cornish bugloss, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, including its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of this plant include expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful in treating coughs, bronchitis, and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Buglossoides arvensis subsp. splitgerberi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
